milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The magenta terracotta structure is centered at spawn-relative (0, 1, 8). Player must navigate within 10 blocks and face it, modeling visual identification of the landmark.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The glass structure is centered at spawn-relative (9, 1, 0). Player must navigate toward the east structure and face it to confirm visual identification.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The orange wall banner is at spawn-relative (-6, 2, 0) on the outside of the barn's east wall. Player must navigate near the barn and face the banner to confirm identification.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because mining removes blocks from the world. The scene places 4 blackstone_stairs blocks in the box around z=8-10. Checking max_count=3 means at least one has been mined. This is distinct from the pickup milestone which checks inventory state.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The black bed is inside the glass structure at spawn-relative (9, 0, 0). Tight max_distance of 5 ensures the player has entered the glass room through the doorway, not just looked from outside.

Uses position_near_with_facing with tight distance (3 blocks) and facing (45°) because bell ringing is a block interaction that cannot be reliably detected via use_item or other event counters. This is the best available proxy — the player must be very close to and directly facing the bell, which is only achievable by intentionally approaching it to interact.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Birch stairs flank the barn doorway at spawn-relative (-7, 0, ±1). Target is the center point (-7, 0, 0). Player must navigate to the barn entrance and face the stairs.

Uses count_in_box_at_most with kind=mob, max_count=0 because hunting means killing the cow. The very generous box (±20 blocks in all directions) ensures the cow cannot wander outside the detection area before being killed, preventing false positives. Only one cow is spawned in the scene.

Uses inventory_has because picking up the mined blackstone_stairs means it appears in the player's inventory. The player does NOT start with blackstone_stairs (only diamond_pickaxe and cobblestone are given), so having ≥1 confirms successful pickup of the mined drop.

Uses two count_in_box_at_least rules together: (1) at least 3 cobblestone blocks placed anywhere in the scene confirms sufficient building, and (2) at least 1 cobblestone at y≥2 confirms vertical stacking (not just flat placement). Together these verify a tower-like vertical structure was built. The player is given 16 cobblestone at start.
